name: claude-motion
description: Use this for a local Motion film: a short animated video (10–30 s unless asked for more, 900 s at most), such as an explainer, product walkthrough or UI demo, launch teaser, logo sting, social clip, animated chart or title sequence, that plays in the bundled Motion player and exports from there to MP4 or GIF. A narrated one carries a voice track: a take a scene, made here with a speech provider of the user's or recorded by them, spoken and captioned by the player, the motion timed to its words.
author: JimLiu
